home.when: my default mailbox's Inbox — the person's own, else the first they can open; a person with no mailbox yet sees why and who can connect one

notice.when: the business's mail-monitoring notice, and to acknowledge it (on first use, and when its version changes)

my-trail.when: my own trail here: what I sent, decided, filed and opened, by mailbox

tokens-list.when: my tokens for the two read MCP servers: label, last used, revoke; mint a new one (shown once)

admin-domains.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-domains.when: MaluMail's hosted domains for the customer key: which this business serves, which are internal, SPF/DKIM/DMARC as last read

admin-mailboxes.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-mailboxes.when: every mailbox of the served domains as cards: kind, owner or overseers, quota and use, sync state, the credential's state, intake owner

admin-mailbox-new.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-mailbox-new.when: create a mailbox — domain, local part, kind, owner (the record picker), quota, overseers and the primary overseer for an agent's

admin-mailbox-view.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-mailbox-view.when: one mailbox for a Mail admin: suspend or reactivate, quota, reset the password (a person's shown once), connect or reconnect the webmail, the credential's state, intake owner, share with applications, overseers

admin-aliases.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-aliases.when: the forwarding addresses of the served domains, outside destinations flagged

admin-alias-new.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-alias-new.when: create a forwarding address — source and destinations, an outside destination confirmed by name

admin-alias-view.section: Domains, mailboxes and forwarding (slice 1 — the CRUD exemplar)
admin-alias-view.when: one forwarding address: edit its destinations, delete it

mailbox-view.section: The mail service and the list (slice 2 — the first exemplar)
mailbox-view.when: a mailbox's view as Gmail's conversation list — `inbox`, `starred`, `snoozed`, `sent`, `drafts`, `scheduled`, `outbox`, `all`, `spam`, `trash` — with select, the bulk bar, stars, labels, the attachment icon, snippets, dates, cursor paging and the "N new" bar

folder-view.section: The mail service and the list (slice 2 — the first exemplar)
folder-view.when: one IMAP folder's conversations, the same list

thread-view.when: one conversation: earlier messages collapsed, quoted text folded, the sandboxed body, attachments, Show images, the outside and sender-mismatch banners, the DMARC result; Reply, Reply all, Forward, Archive, Delete, Spam, Move, Label, Snooze, Mute, Mark unread, Print, Show original; Take over on an agent's mailbox

message-original.when: one message's headers and source, and the `.eml` download

compose.when: write new mail, or a reply or forward — From (identities), To/Cc/Bcc with autocomplete, subject, the editor (rich or plain), attachments, the signature, canned replies; Send, Schedule, Save draft, Discard; Undo after Send

draft-edit.when: go on with a draft — one written here or on a phone

identity-new.when: add an address this mailbox sends as — its own, or an alias MaluMail delivers to it — with display name, reply-to and signature

identity-edit.when: change an identity's display name, reply-to, signature or default

oversight.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
oversight.when: a card per agent mailbox I oversee: received, sent, held, rejected (7 days), last activity, Pause/Resume

review-queue.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
review-queue.when: the held mail waiting for me — the overseers', and a person's own for an agent's mail from their mailbox — oldest first, with its reasons

review-view.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
review-view.when: one held message as it will go out, beside the conversation it answers, the agent's purpose, its run and every hold reason; Approve, Edit, Reject with a note, Reply to the agent, Take over

review-edit.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
review-edit.when: edit a held message before sending it — the edit kept as a diff

unscreened.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
unscreened.when: mail that did not wake an agent: Release (one turn), Mark sender known, Spam, Dismiss

agent-policy.section: Agents' mail and oversight (slice 5 — the fourth exemplar)
agent-policy.when: an agent mailbox's sending policy with each setting's meaning, its pause switch and its history

search.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
search.when: conversations of one mailbox matching Gmail's operators

search-all.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
search-all.when: the same over every mailbox I can open, each result naming its mailbox

label-view.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)

folders.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
folders.when: a mailbox's IMAP folders: create, rename, delete, counts

labels.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
labels.when: a mailbox's labels: create, rename, colour, delete, counts

templates.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
templates.when: my canned replies and the shared ones

template-new.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)

template-edit.section: Search, labels, snooze, folders and templates (slice 6)
template-edit.when: change or delete a canned reply

mailbox-access.when: who can open this mailbox and at what level, and why (owner, a row, a department, Mail admin, the Clerk); revoke

access-grant-new.when: give a person, a department or an agent a level on this mailbox (the record picker); on a person's mailbox by anyone but its owner, the break-glass form with a reason and an expiry

mailbox-access-log.when: every view of this mailbox by anyone but its owner — lists, conversations, parts, raw, MCP and K7 reads

mailbox-settings.when: this mailbox's settings: undo seconds, conversation view, images, density, shortcuts; on a person's mailbox, **Let the Mail Expert read my mail when I ask** and **Share with applications** (both off by default)

correspondents.when: everyone this mailbox has written to or heard from: first and last contact, counts, known or not, internal or outside

correspondent-view.when: what this mailbox has exchanged with one address or its company's domain, as conversations

notifications.when: my notices: new mail in the mailboxes I chose, held mail for my review, decisions, unscreened mail, break-glass on my mailbox, failures

notification-settings.when: which notices reach me in-app, by mail and by text (K6), and for which mailboxes new mail notifies me

admin.when: the Mail admin's overview: domains served, mailboxes by kind and state, forwarding addresses going outside, sync health, failed credentials, the agents' budget today

admin-sync.when: per mailbox: sync state, last sync, index and text coverage, errors; Re-sync, Re-index text

admin-settings.when: MaluMail's settings: the undo and images defaults, the body index cap, held-mail expiry, the agent policy defaults, the agents' business-wide budget and its two switches, the monitoring notice, the Clerk's hour

admin-agents.when: the agents with mailboxes, their mail turns (dispatches) and their states; Retry a failed one
